description: This file defines the Success controller class for the checkout success page in OpenCart. It handles initializing the success page, clearing session data related to the order, setting up breadcrumb navigation, preparing the message for logged-in or guest users, and rendering the success view.

classes.name: Success
classes.description: Controller class for handling the checkout success page, extending the core Controller class in Opencart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that handles rendering the success page, clearing session data related to the order, setting breadcrumbs, and preparing user message based on login status.
